title: Several such sites around the world
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Several such sites around the world, about an unknown time at Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's several different sites all over the world.

plain: Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge craft in the Indonesian jungle, told podcast host Jesse Michels that such sites are not unique. Citing a man named Jake Barber, he says there are several of these sites around the world, including in Southeast Asia and Mexico. If true, it would point to a wider, hidden network of such locations.
